name: quox-security
tagline: The permission slip a security test has to pass before it runs.
description: Security testing engagement/scope substrate: authorization, target verification, and adversarially-verified findings. In development, Phase 1 of 5. No live scan capability is reachable from this UI yet, that lives in chat and the CLI once a bastion-managed scan host exists.
shortDescription: Security testing engagement management, in development
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Every capability call passes a real policy gate: scope, verification, risk ceiling, time window
Domain verification via DNS TXT or a well-known file, SSRF-guarded
4 chat-reachable specialist agents, all policy-gated the same way the UI is
Adversarially-verified findings: a confirmed or refuted verdict always carries a reason

engagementScope.name: Engagement scope
engagementScope.description: Create an engagement, set its environment tier and risk ceiling, add and verify targets.

findingsReview.name: Findings
findingsReview.description: Candidate findings and their adversarially-reached verdicts, read here once an agent or the CLI reports one.
